what: The page's pickers: every shipped run's bb-run/1 record (relative to site/data/, listed in state.json's playback slice), its objective, whether it passed every gate, and the build's honesty checks on its saved samples. tools/build_site.py writes it; site/README.md states the rule.

rule.text: Every scored solution not tagged `ablation` (from ledger.jsonl, its latest dev row) on the first dev task of each task kind; the best admissible solution and the best admissible generation-0 solution on all 42 dev tasks.

solutions.change: Refit the inherited feedforward model once using dev tracking errors at its configured gains
Change the board damping multiplier from 2.0 to 1.85
Give every dev task equal total sample weight during the p5s-pass3 identification pass
identification pass 3 (identify_pass.py on p5s-onefit's dev runs), added into model.json

kd x1.5 instead of x2 at kp x4 (zeta 0.50 -> 0.37): less kd times the 2^14-count velocity estimate
kd x2.5 instead of x2 at kp x4 (zeta 0.50 -> 0.62): p5s-kd15 showed damping is worth more than the kd buzz it brings
ff minus kd·tau_v·qdd per joint: the board's velocity estimate lags by encoder delay + 1/(2π·filter Hz) (1.3 ms), so its kd term pushes ahead while accelerating
middle rung (kp x2): second joint-error pass on p5s-kp2's dev runs, gravity shapes + friction basis + own-qdd term, subtracted (as p5s-fric2-pass2 did at x1)

friction correction in target qd (odd multi-scale tanh basis + qd), fitted from p5s-grav's dev joint errors (kp·e + kd·ė), subtracted from the ff
ff minus a gravity-shaped torque error per joint, fitted from p5s-chord's dev joint errors (kp·e + kd·ė on sin/cos of q2, q2+q3, q2+q3+q4, × cos/sin q5)

position sent = sample - a(s+T/2)·T²/12: the board's straight walk over a host period becomes the least-squares line of the curve, not its chord
